---
title: "Data privacy and intellectual property"
description: "What can safely go into an AI tool, and what stays out?"
---

Every prompt sends text, data, or files to a company's servers. For unpublished results, manuscripts under review, and ideas that may lead to patents, this raises questions of privacy and ownership.

## Open questions

- Which kinds of material are safe to share with AI tools: published papers, unpublished data, draft manuscripts, grant proposals, reviews?
- How do institutional accounts differ from personal accounts in how providers store and use what we send?
- Does sharing an idea or dataset with an AI tool affect later patent applications or publication?
- Which tools does the University of Copenhagen approve for which kinds of data?
